course_name_original: Organization and Management of a Company
course_name_en: Organization and Management of a Company

learning_outcomes.text: Teach the basics in organizing and managing the activities in a modern company.
Facilitate using managerial skills in practice.

syllabus_topics: Development of the science for managing a company
Marketing as part of company’s activities
Organizational and legal aspects of a company
assessment_rules: The final grade is a result of a written exam. Students come to the exam at the same time and get three identical questions. The final mark depends on their answers. Each student can also choose to take three tests during the semester, graded according to the six-grade estimation scale, and the final mark is an average of these three tests.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
